caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted eagle, viewed in profile and facing left. The eagle has a prominently hooked beak, open as if calling, and a sharply defined eye. Its feathers are rendered in shades of brown and gold, creating a layered effect across its wings and body. The eagle’s wings are partially open, angled upwards and backwards, with detailed feather patterns visible. The eagle’s talons grip a rounded, green object that has a twisted, rope-like texture and hints of red. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color with no additional objects or scenery, making the eagle the central focus of the composition.
title: Eagle from Tugboat Wheelhouse
